title: Manually Reference/Position Tipper End Effector for Maintenance Using Visu_Dual_MCP (Navigate + CYCLE STOP)
summary: Navigate to the Visu_Dual_MCP screen on the operator station HMI and press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle so the end effector can be manually positioned for maintenance procedures.
when_to_use: Use when maintenance requires manually moving the tipper end effector into position, and you need to stop the automatic tipping cycle first.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the operator station HMI to the Visu_Dual_MCP screen and press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle for maintenance positioning.
safety_notes: Only maintenance personnel should jog the tipper (JOG is described as maintenance personnel use only in the operator station control panel figure).
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (operator station HMI)

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen for manually referencing axes; shows navigation to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3) and the CYCLE STOP step.

steps.title: Navigate to the Visu_Dual_MCP screen (F3) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct HMI screen that contains the CYCLE STOP control used to halt the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The operator station HMI is displaying the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen is active and ready for control inputs (including CYCLE STOP).
steps.failure_condition: The HMI is not on the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3), so CYCLE STOP cannot be applied to stop the automatic tipping cycle.

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle
steps.purpose: Stop the automatic tipping cycle so the end effector can be manually moved into position for maintenance.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE STOP on the Visu_Dual_MCP screen to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The automatic tipping cycle is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing CYCLE STOP, the system is no longer running the automatic tipping cycle (cycle is halted), enabling manual positioning for maintenance.
steps.failure_condition: The automatic tipping cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.

actions.label: Stop automatic cycle
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the automatic tipping cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP, stop and escalate for support rather than attempting manual movement.

success_criteria: Visu_Dual_MCP screen (F3) is displayed on the operator station HMI.
Automatic tipping cycle is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
healthy_conditions: CYCLE STOP successfully halts the automatic tipping cycle, allowing manual end-effector positioning for maintenance.
failure_conditions: Automatic tipping cycle continues running after pressing CYCLE STOP.
escalation_guidance: If CYCLE STOP does not stop the automatic tipping cycle, stop and escalate for support rather than attempting manual movement.
missing_details: The provided excerpt and evidence for this candidate cover only navigating to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3) and pressing CYCLE STOP. The manual end-effector movement/jogging actions themselves are not included in the provided excerpt for this specific candidate.
